topStories.headline: July Payrolls Unexpectedly Fall 23,000, Triggering Recession Debate
topStories.summary: The US economy shed 23,000 jobs in July, far below the 83,000 expected, driven by 53,000 government job cuts; private payrolls rose 30,000 while wage growth slowed to 3.2% YoY — the lowest since May 2021.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ Fed rate-hike odds to ~44% for September (from 67%); ↑ Treasuries; equities mixed on recession fears

topStories.headline: Oil Holds Near $82 as Oman-Iran Strait of Hormuz Accord Remains Elusive
topStories.summary: Iran said an Oman-brokered shipping deal is 'very close' but ruled out direct US talks; WTI crude near $82/bbl after surging ~9% over three sessions following the collapse of a June interim peace agreement.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ XOM, CVX, XLE on sustained supply disruption; ↑ inflation risk weighs on broader equities

topStories.headline: July CPI Due Wednesday — Inflation Data in Focus After Jobs Miss
topStories.summary: US July Consumer Price Index releases August 12 at 8:30 AM ET; June CPI ran +3.5% YoY with core at +2.6%, and markets are watching closely as the data will determine whether the Fed restarts its hiking cycle.
topStories.marketImpact: Hot print ↓ equities, ↑ yields; cool print could fuel ↑ rally in SPY and TLT

topStories.headline: AI Earnings Gauntlet: CoreWeave Tonight, Cisco Wednesday, Applied Materials Thursday
topStories.summary: The week's most consequential earnings arrive: CoreWeave reports after today's close; Cisco reports Wednesday with AI networking revenue guided to $9B for FY2026; Applied Materials reports Thursday with consensus of ~$9B revenue (+23% YoY).
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ or ↓ CRWV, CSCO, AMAT, SMCI — results will set the tone for the AI infrastructure capex narrative

topStories.headline: MiniMax Soars 17% on Hong Kong Stock Connect Debut, Drawing HK$2.7B in Mainland Flows
topStories.summary: Chinese AI startup MiniMax (0100.HK) was added to the Stock Connect on August 6 and surged over 17% as southbound mainland investors poured in a net HK$2.7 billion in buying on its first day of eligibility.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ 0100.HK; ↑ broader HK AI/tech sentiment; watch 0700.HK, 9988.HK on sector rotation

topStories.headline: China's AI Boom Drives Export Surge, But Economists Warn of K-Shaped Economy
topStories.summary: China's exports jumped 27% YoY in June to $412.4B — the fastest pace since late 2021 — fuelled by AI-linked hardware, but Caixin analysis warns this masks structural inequality as household consumption lags well behind.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ Chinese tech exporters; ↓ domestic consumer discretionary; gold elevated on PBoC buying 19.9t in July

topStories.headline: Japan AI Chipmakers Surge as Nikkei Ends Mixed; BOJ Holds Rates at 1%
topStories.summary: Fujikura (+7.6%), Advantest (+6.4%), and Tokyo Electron (+4.1%) led gains in AI-linked semiconductor names Friday, but the Nikkei 225 still slipped 0.28% to 65,500 overall; the Bank of Japan left rates unchanged at 1.00%.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ 5803.T, 6857.T on AI data centre demand; yen under pressure as BOJ stays on hold

topStories.headline: Southeast Asia Manufacturing PMI Rebounds Sharply to 52.8 in July
topStories.summary: The region's manufacturing PMI jumped from an 11-month low of 50.5 in June to 52.8 in July, led by faster growth in new orders and production as supply chains adjust to the Hormuz shock.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ regional equity ETFs; positive read for Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand manufacturing and logistics plays

topStories.headline: India's Biggest Equity Market Reform in Years Faces Volatile First Week
topStories.summary: India launched a new closing auction system for equities — one of its most significant market structure changes in years — but the reform experienced notable volatility in its first week as participants adapted.
topStories.marketImpact: Short-term ↓ BSE/NSE intraday volatility; medium-term structural ↑ for Indian equity market depth
